locations.note: Nancy and George join the Pacific Run reality contest at its base camp, where the first challenges are trains and plants.
Team Tui's challenge at the woolshed; George is badly hurt in a fall from the rope bridge, and Bess takes her place.
Nancy races kayaks between buoys and takes a minisub down from the underwater observatory.
Nancy works through two old gold-mine tunnels for a piece of the medallion.
In a cave on the lake Nancy deciphers Māori symbols for the last piece and confronts the man behind the contest.

routes.name: The Pacific Run
routes.note: The contest's five stages, from the base camp on Lake Wakatipu to the final cave on Lake Te Anau.
